verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform, so event-driven automation rules are a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence shows no rule engine or event-triggered action feature. Reflexes only label text, which is a developer building block. The canary migration compares Reflex results before you switch rather than automatically triggering actions when events occur.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
